name: Viridescent-Requiem
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a tidally locked hemisphere, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.

For traders, rare flora, titanium, copper and solar potential alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
